class.name: FellowMotionMatcher3D
class.brief_description: FellowEngine: motion matching on a [Skeleton3D] — clips searched for the frame that continues the pose and follows the desired trajectory, blended by inertialization, feet locked with IK.
class.description: A modifier of a [Skeleton3D] whose bones are a [FellowMotionDatabase]'s. Gameplay sets [member desired_velocity] (and [member desired_facing]); a simulated character follows them with critically damped springs, and every [member search_interval] its predicted trajectory (1/3, 2/3 and 1 s ahead, relative to the character) and the current frame's pose features query the database. The best frame, when it is not the current one, is blended in by inertialization. The character's root ([member root_path], by default the skeleton's parent) moves with the animation's own root motion, pulled towards the simulation within [member clamp_distance]; the skeleton's transform relative to it is taken as identity, the root's +Z as forward. Feet in contact are locked and reached with two-bone IK. With [member lod_distances] it searches less often, then skips the IK and updates at a quarter of the rate farther from the camera. See [code]docs/decisions/0149-motion-matching.md[/code].

method.name: advance
method.description: One update: the simulation, the search when due, playback, inertialization, the root's motion and the feet. Called by the skeleton's modifier processing when [member auto_update] is on.

method.name: advance_group
method.description: [method advance] for several matchers at once: their updates run on the [WorkerThreadPool], then their roots are moved on the calling thread. Use it with [member auto_update] off.

method.name: get_character_position
method.description: Where the character's root is (the animation's root motion pulled towards the simulation).

method.name: get_foot_positions
method.description: The left and right ankles after the IK, in world space.

method.name: get_global_stats
method.description: Every matcher's updates, searches (count, microseconds, frames checked), transitions and updates per LOD since [method reset_global_stats].

method.name: get_last_search
method.description: The last search's query, result and current features in their units, the frame and clip found, its cost.

method.name: get_lod
method.description: The LOD level of the last update (0-2).

method.name: get_simulation_position
method.description: The simulated character's position (where gameplay put it).

method.name: get_stats
method.description: This matcher's searches, transitions, search microseconds, foot sliding while in contact ([code]foot_slide_distance[/code], [code]foot_slide_locked[/code], [code]foot_slide_raised[/code] (of it with the foot raised 1 cm or more by [member foot_step_lift]: stepping), [code]foot_contact_time[/code], [code]foot_slide_speed[/code]), a foot in the air going over the ground under 1 cm over it ([code]foot_skim_distance[/code], [code]foot_air_time[/code]: milestone 187), [code]trajectory_error[/code] (the mean distance between the character and the simulation), popping ([code]pop_p50_mm[/code], [code]pop_p99_mm[/code], [code]pop_p999_mm[/code], [code]pop_max_mm[/code]: per frame the largest second difference of the hips' and legs' joints), the clip, frame and LOD. With [member ground_adaptation]: [code]hips_drop_mm[/code] (how far the hips are lowered now) and [code]hips_drop_min_mm[/code] (the lowest since [method reset_stats]), [code]ground_offsets_mm[/code] (each foot's ground over the root's, as a [Vector2]: left, right), [code]ground_shifts_mm[/code] (how far [member foot_grounding] moves each foot now: left, right), and [code]toe_positions[/code] (where the toes were shown, global).

method.name: is_pushed
method.description: Milestone 183: a [method push] is under way.

method.name: play_from
method.description: Milestone 184 (decision 0326): puts the character at [param position] facing [param facing] (as [method teleport]) showing the database's [param frame] as it is, without a blend from the pose before — a clip played by something else (a get-up of [FellowPhysicalAnimation3D]'s balance) handed back where it ends. It goes on from there: its next search, by the trajectory alone, finds what follows, blended in as any transition, the feet held where they stand ([member foot_locking]) until the new pose's are further than [member unlock_radius] and step there ([member foot_step_lift]).

method.name: push
method.description: Milestone 183 (decision 0325): the character pushed off its course — a stagger. For [param duration] seconds the desired velocity is [param velocity] (its horizontal part), decaying to nothing, the facing held where it is (its back and side steps if the push is so); then [member desired_velocity] and [member desired_facing] again. [method teleport] ends it. [FellowPhysicalAnimation3D]'s balance calls it.

method.name: reset
method.description: Starts again from the root's transform at the next update.

method.name: teleport
method.description: Puts the simulation and the character at [param position] facing [param facing], at rest.

members.member: How fast the character is pulled towards the simulation (the adjustment's half-life, limited to half the root's own speed).
Update in the skeleton's modifier processing; off: call [method advance].
The character never farther from the simulation than this.
The motion to match.
The direction to face; zero: the direction of [member desired_velocity].
The velocity on the ground the character should reach.

Milestone 185 (decision 0327): a foot in contact (the database's contacts) stands on the ground — lowered (or raised, by up to 5 cm; lowered by up to 8) so that the lower of its ankle (where it is held) and its toe (the animation's, from the ankle) is as high over the root's ground as the database's are when the feet are down ([method FellowMotionDatabase.get_foot_ground_height]), springing there in 0.04 s (with [member foot_ik]). Recordings' floors differ: half of the feet held down stood 2-5 cm over the ground. [method get_stats]' [code]ground_shifts_mm[/code].
Two-bone IK of the legs reaching the locked feet.
A foot in contact (the database's contacts) stays where it landed until it lifts or the animation pulls it [member unlock_radius] away.

Milestone 187 (decision 0329): a foot down (its contact on) but not held by [member foot_locking] that moves over the ground — stepping to where its animation went ([member foot_step_lift]), or carried by a transition's blend between two stances — is lifted by its speed (0.12 s of it, at most half of [member foot_step_lift], its step's arc counted), whether the character stands or not; and [member foot_grounding] keeps such a foot's step's arc rather than taking it back down to the ground. Off: milestone 186's feet, which slid 14-26 cm over the ground through a stagger's steps at 1-1.6 m/s. Needs [member foot_step_lift] above [code]0[/code].

Milestone 184 (decision 0326): feet that would slide over the ground step instead (with [member foot_ik]). A foot held by [member foot_locking] and let go of because its animation is [member unlock_radius] away while still on the ground is not held again until it has stepped there, lifted on an arc (a parabola over the way, 40 % of it high, at most this); held again at once, it crept along the ground. A foot let go of more than 4 cm from its animation as it lifts gets the same arc on top of its own. A foot the animation drags along low while the character stands (a shuffle: a clip's, or a transition's blend between two stances) is lifted by 0.12 s of its speed, at most half of this. 0: milestone 183's feet.

Fits the character to uneven ground (milestone 56): rays straight down against the physics world (the bodies of [member ground_collision_mask]) under the root and under each foot's heel and toe, cast on the main thread before each update. The root follows the ground's height under it (eased), each foot is placed on the highest ground under it — its height over the root's ground added to the animated foot's — by the leg's two-bone IK (onto higher ground four times as fast as down: a foot landing on a step does not sink into it), the hips are lowered as far as the lower foot must reach down (so that the leg over higher ground bends instead of the other overstretching), and a foot that is down turns to the ground's slope ([member ground_alignment], at most 35 degrees). On flat ground the pose is the one without it. Needs [member foot_ik] for the feet.
With [member ground_adaptation], a foot in contact turns to the slope of the ground under it.
The physics layers [member ground_adaptation]'s rays hit (leave the characters' own bodies out).
With [member ground_adaptation], the feet placed on the ground and the hips lowered; [code]false[/code]: only the root follows the ground's height.
How fast the feet's ground offsets and the hips follow the ground (the root at twice this), in seconds to halve the difference.
How far above and below the character's ground [member ground_adaptation] looks for ground, in metres: the highest step up or down it follows in a frame, and the farthest a foot is moved.
Transitions blended by inertialization (the offset between the poses decays); off: hard cuts.
The offsets' half-life.

How far the body leans into the acceleration the character has and its animation does not (milestone 164): a turn sharper or a start quicker than the clip's. The whole body turns about the ground under the hips by [code]atan(a / g)[/code] times this, sideways in full and forwards half as much, with the feet held where they were by the leg IK ([member foot_ik]). [code]0[/code]: no lean.
The largest lean, sideways and forwards (radians).
Distances from the camera: beyond the first, searches half as often and no foot IK; beyond the second, a quarter as often and updates at a quarter of the rate.

Orientation warping (milestone 165): when the clip found goes another way than the simulation (a strafe between the database's, a walk at an angle to [member desired_facing]), the hips turn about the vertical towards the simulation's way, by at most [member orientation_warping_max_angle], and the spine turns back over its bones so that the chest keeps the facing. The root motion turns with them. The spine is found from the hips: the child that leads to neither leg, then on while a bone has one child.
The largest turn of the hips (radians).
The node moved with the character; empty: the skeleton's parent.
The simulation's turning half-life.
Seconds between searches (and a search when the desired velocity changes by 0.1 m/s, or the clip ends).

Stride warping (milestone 164): each foot's place along the way the character goes is scaled about the hips by the character's speed over its animation's (within [member stride_warping_limits]), so that a stride covers the ground the character covers and a planted foot does not slide; the hips come down where a leg must reach farther. Needs [member foot_ik].
The shortest and the longest stride, as factors of the animation's.
Pull the character towards the simulation (and clamp it); off: the root follows the animation alone.
Clips with any of these tags (the database's [code]tags[/code] build option; [code]"mirrored"[/code] for mirrored clips) are not searched (milestone 56).

Only clips with all of these tags are searched (milestone 56): gameplay states as sets of clips (e.g. [code]["crouch"][/code]). When the clip playing leaves them, the next update searches at once. A tag no clip has matches nothing.

The playing pose continues unless a frame of the database is cheaper than it by this much, in the search's cost (milestone 164): fewer transitions, each worth its blend. [code]0[/code]: the cheapest frame wins.
Frames of the playing clip within this many seconds of the current one are not searched (milestone 164): a jump of a few frames within the same clip is a stutter, not a transition.
A locked foot is released when the animation's foot is this far from it.
The simulation's acceleration half-life.
